name: Wayfarer
desc: Forgiving combat and generous loot for players focused on story and exploration.
flavor: Even Thornwick's mud seems inclined to let your boots pull free.
warning: Enemies strike softer and miss more often; tactical errors rarely prove fatal.

name: Sellsword
desc: Balanced steel and sorcery—the intended march across Thornvael.
flavor: Honest pay for honest scars, provided you keep your shields in front.
warning: Careless positioning will cost mercenaries; smart use of pause and formations prevails.

name: Ironbound
desc: Deadlier foes, tighter gold, and merciless ambushes across every province.
flavor: Every bridge is watched, every potion counts, and nobody forgives a flanking slip.
warning: Enemies use sharper tactics and hit harder. Expect to reload if you march blind.

name: Ashen Oath
desc: Brutal lethality where single mistakes wipe entire companies in seconds.
flavor: The Ember Court already has your grave dug; prove them premature.
warning: Designed for veterans who pause every heartbeat and optimize every copper coin.
